description: Chemical Guys Mat Renew Rubber + Vinyl Floor Mat Cleaner and Protectant (946 ml) is the ultimate solution to deep-clean and restore your vehicle's rubber mats and floor liners. Whether your mats are covered in mud, road salt, or everyday grime, Mat Renew breaks down the mess and brings back a like-new finish—without a greasy or slippery feel. This professional-grade formula cleans, conditions, and protects rubber and vinyl mats in one easy step. Mat Renew penetrates deep to remove embedded dirt, oils, and residue while restoring the natural deep black appearance of rubber. Unlike harsh degreasers or silicone sprays, it won’t make your mats slick or dangerous underfoot. Perfect for all vehicles—including cars, trucks, SUVs, motorcycles, and RVs—Mat Renew also features built-in UV blockers to protect rubber from cracking, fading, and aging due to sun exposure. How to Use: Rinse mats thoroughly with clean water. Spray Mat Renew directly onto the surface. Scrub with a stiff bristle brush to lift dirt and grime. Rinse clean and allow to dry. Reinstall mats and secure fasteners if applicable. Mat Renew delivers professional results every time—keeping your mats clean, your interior sharp, and your ride protected.
